![This Is What Happens When You Mix Tums And Alcohol](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/11240727-1853-0139-0000-7dd6f79bff3b:4)
Taking Tums (calcium carbonate) alongside alcohol is ` [Highlight start] generally safe because there is no known direct drug interaction between them [Highlight end] ` . However, alcohol can trigger heartburn and make Tums less effective if you keep drinking.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXDwq3cn-Ka1ksXiboSwObiQPoDUGglf1u1-wowQtSh64v2GXsi9TY37hvbKSBhE6SoPMREZ0OOgw8fRG5vW6Sw006TBInsex3xshZl1iet4j_yAPF9XmJ2TFDTGaO91DyeYgweOUbeXw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXb6ko64A07v4q4tsshlwtOykIWNRgmQocB0c_ybqZ21dAh-4DMVCP0i2bEBhYMw4n3dCPYTNKa60LfV1HjZB6HTK4Lh0f-yuKkab-1uhBGVGyjAF-5WHY0fgnlrXfAPRvvpV2uiBBs4C9Z1TJiw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXX-sw9uE2kIrggYkLSQ_63wz-3rq6vn9i586_-DardMe0bZJcSq3jsOc2zaxFxrevVUVtH69DxownaoaWSxg5OV2deYD3caAB0kUiLhv8RYtSsjiaHXEXkuhpqva7-XW0OW9Xrlmi5FE6dz1n2d8nlCed-1VL9sXs)

### How Alcohol and Tums Interact

- **Why alcohol causes heartburn:** Alcohol relaxes the lower esophageal sphincter and increases stomach acid, allowing acid to reflux into your esophagus.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXDwq3cn-Ka1ksXiboSwObiQPoDUGglf1u1-wowQtSh64v2GXsi9TY37hvbKSBhE6SoPMREZ0OOgw8fRG5vW6Sw006TBInsex3xshZl1iet4j_yAPF9XmJ2TFDTGaO91DyeYgweOUbeXw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXX-sw9uE2kIrggYkLSQ_63wz-3rq6vn9i586_-DardMe0bZJcSq3jsOc2zaxFxrevVUVtH69DxownaoaWSxg5OV2deYD3caAB0kUiLhv8RYtSsjiaHXEXkuhpqva7-XW0OW9Xrlmi5FE6dz1n2d8nlCed-1VL9sXs)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXbJcBB31yzCmi6OQL85qXqq4kacwdY9NyL30I47_E8o3JAzU9ExczWBAr2WghnhEvcfet1Kmw_ijBPyzmbCKSKSjvB_YiZeV05mHhkLwL-iYeH66wbHDlnK9BD1-H8qXgisBBLE-3W8Z-PeX8tX6NrCp7pZZcLTjJGA)
- **How Tums helps:** Tums neutralizes existing stomach acid to ease heartburn, indigestion, or sour stomach.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXb6ko64A07v4q4tsshlwtOykIWNRgmQocB0c_ybqZ21dAh-4DMVCP0i2bEBhYMw4n3dCPYTNKa60LfV1HjZB6HTK4Lh0f-yuKkab-1uhBGVGyjAF-5WHY0fgnlrXfAPRvvpV2uiBBs4C9Z1TJiw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXDwq3cn-Ka1ksXiboSwObiQPoDUGglf1u1-wowQtSh64v2GXsi9TY37hvbKSBhE6SoPMREZ0OOgw8fRG5vW6Sw006TBInsex3xshZl1iet4j_yAPF9XmJ2TFDTGaO91DyeYgweOUbeXw)
- **Limitations:** Tums treats symptoms after they start rather than preventing heartburn before you drink, and it will not prevent a hangover. Continued drinking can overpower its relief.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESVQHEIkXXgd_7Fut9mbJYdMkvb5p1fWzZJRkmJBRUIAo0V27BMaEgU3w9DofMJwzzYEz32A9MjCuzmgRbTY0cjiSWq-tHPFIgVhvDdm0qJ8mJoozqxfM)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXb6ko64A07v4q4tsshlwtOykIWNRgmQocB0c_ybqZ21dAh-4DMVCP0i2bEBhYMw4n3dCPYTNKa60LfV1HjZB6HTK4Lh0f-yuKkab-1uhBGVGyjAF-5WHY0fgnlrXfAPRvvpV2uiBBs4C9Z1TJiw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXX-sw9uE2kIrggYkLSQ_63wz-3rq6vn9i586_-DardMe0bZJcSq3jsOc2zaxFxrevVUVtH69DxownaoaWSxg5OV2deYD3caAB0kUiLhv8RYtSsjiaHXEXkuhpqva7-XW0OW9Xrlmi5FE6dz1n2d8nlCed-1VL9sXs)

### Key Precautions

- **Stick to dosage limits:** Taking too much calcium carbonate can cause side effects like constipation, gas, or stomach pain, and high amounts over time can lead to dangerously high calcium levels.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXDwq3cn-Ka1ksXiboSwObiQPoDUGglf1u1-wowQtSh64v2GXsi9TY37hvbKSBhE6SoPMREZ0OOgw8fRG5vW6Sw006TBInsex3xshZl1iet4j_yAPF9XmJ2TFDTGaO91DyeYgweOUbeXw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXb6ko64A07v4q4tsshlwtOykIWNRgmQocB0c_ybqZ21dAh-4DMVCP0i2bEBhYMw4n3dCPYTNKa60LfV1HjZB6HTK4Lh0f-yuKkab-1uhBGVGyjAF-5WHY0fgnlrXfAPRvvpV2uiBBs4C9Z1TJiw)
- **Watch for other medications:** Space Tums apart from other medications (often by at least two to four hours) as directed on the label or by a pharmacist, since antacids can affect how other drugs are absorbed.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXDwq3cn-Ka1ksXiboSwObiQPoDUGglf1u1-wowQtSh64v2GXsi9TY37hvbKSBhE6SoPMREZ0OOgw8fRG5vW6Sw006TBInsex3xshZl1iet4j_yAPF9XmJ2TFDTGaO91DyeYgweOUbeXw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESVQHEIkXXgd_7Fut9mbJYdMkvb5p1fWzZJRkmJBRUIAo0V27BMaEgU3w9DofMJwzzYEz32A9MjCuzmgRbTY0cjiSWq-tHPFIgVhvDdm0qJ8mJoozqxfM)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXX-sw9uE2kIrggYkLSQ_63wz-3rq6vn9i586_-DardMe0bZJcSq3jsOc2zaxFxrevVUVtH69DxownaoaWSxg5OV2deYD3caAB0kUiLhv8RYtSsjiaHXEXkuhpqva7-XW0OW9Xrlmi5FE6dz1n2d8nlCed-1VL9sXs)
- **Check product ingredients:** Make sure you are taking standard calcium carbonate Tums rather than a combination product containing aspirin or other active ingredients that may irritate the stomach with alcohol.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXb6ko64A07v4q4tsshlwtOykIWNRgmQocB0c_ybqZ21dAh-4DMVCP0i2bEBhYMw4n3dCPYTNKa60LfV1HjZB6HTK4Lh0f-yuKkab-1uhBGVGyjAF-5WHY0fgnlrXfAPRvvpV2uiBBs4C9Z1TJiw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXX_GaEyp_AjYcfSlSPcjgm4HR6vOJcCxXbYw4kOTy4bFfSgl2PF835jd8YObAj_RGMvTbDOooLdVTsMcmc8yV4oVpOdUa5v0xsw_dO1qfS0LodSVrAEsgP6Yl2_FUjNAAth9juAOIt-k5ubhZ2-cu0rZk)
- **Know when to get checked out:** See a doctor if heartburn happens frequently, lasts more than two weeks, or comes with severe pain or trouble swallowing.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXDwq3cn-Ka1ksXiboSwObiQPoDUGglf1u1-wowQtSh64v2GXsi9TY37hvbKSBhE6SoPMREZ0OOgw8fRG5vW6Sw006TBInsex3xshZl1iet4j_yAPF9XmJ2TFDTGaO91DyeYgweOUbeXw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXb6ko64A07v4q4tsshlwtOykIWNRgmQocB0c_ybqZ21dAh-4DMVCP0i2bEBhYMw4n3dCPYTNKa60LfV1HjZB6HTK4Lh0f-yuKkab-1uhBGVGyjAF-5WHY0fgnlrXfAPRvvpV2uiBBs4C9Z1TJiw)

You can read more about mixing them on [Healthline](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXDwq3cn-Ka1ksXiboSwObiQPoDUGglf1u1-wowQtSh64v2GXsi9TY37hvbKSBhE6SoPMREZ0OOgw8fRG5vW6Sw006TBInsex3xshZl1iet4j_yAPF9XmJ2TFDTGaO91DyeYgweOUbeXw) or [Verywell Health](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXb6ko64A07v4q4tsshlwtOykIWNRgmQocB0c_ybqZ21dAh-4DMVCP0i2bEBhYMw4n3dCPYTNKa60LfV1HjZB6HTK4Lh0f-yuKkab-1uhBGVGyjAF-5WHY0fgnlrXfAPRvvpV2uiBBs4C9Z1TJiw).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXDwq3cn-Ka1ksXiboSwObiQPoDUGglf1u1-wowQtSh64v2GXsi9TY37hvbKSBhE6SoPMREZ0OOgw8fRG5vW6Sw006TBInsex3xshZl1iet4j_yAPF9XmJ2TFDTGaO91DyeYgweOUbeXw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXb6ko64A07v4q4tsshlwtOykIWNRgmQocB0c_ybqZ21dAh-4DMVCP0i2bEBhYMw4n3dCPYTNKa60LfV1HjZB6HTK4Lh0f-yuKkab-1uhBGVGyjAF-5WHY0fgnlrXfAPRvvpV2uiBBs4C9Z1TJiw)If you'd like more tailored information, let me know:

- **Are you having symptoms right now** , or planning ahead before drinking?
- **What symptoms** are you dealing with (like heartburn, nausea, or stomach pain)?
- **Do you take any daily medications** or have conditions like GERD?

items.text: Stick to dosage limits: Taking too much calcium carbonate can cause side effects like constipation, gas, or stomach pain, and high amounts over time can lead to dangerously high calcium levels. Check product ingredients: Make sure you are taking standard calcium carbonate Tums rather than a combination product containing aspirin or other active ingredients that may irritate the stomach with alcohol. Know when to get checked out: See a doctor if heartburn happens frequently, lasts more than two weeks, or comes with severe pain or trouble swallowing.
